card.name: Excessive before blood pressure changes
card.fires_on: The word right after "an" (or "a") such as excessive or extreme, just before a blood pressure drop or rise, e.g. hypotensive effect, reduction, or hypertensive crisis.

modes.label: An excessive/extreme
modes.description: An intensifier after "an" that leads into a blood pressure change.
modes.example: may occasionally experience an<< excessive>> reduction of blood pressure after initiation of therapy

modes.label: A before a BP event
modes.description: The article "a" after cause or precipitate, before a decrease or crisis.
modes.example: MAOIs may precipitate<< a>> hypertensive crisis in such patients.

card.writes: Suppresses variation-type words, so it pushes toward a blood pressure change term rather than a "variation" wording.
card.plain: It marks the spot where the text is about to describe a too-large drop or rise in blood pressure.
